import os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

expected="5dcb550375737c002dbff316121ed1d0c71a27dc"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected or branch!="feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} branch={branch}")

                patch("do_again.cli._ensure_control_worktree") as ensure_control,
                redirect_stdout(output),
            ):

new='''            real_run = subprocess.run
            def doctor_git(argv, *args, **kwargs):
                if argv[:4] == ["git", "-C", str(layout.control_worktree), "rev-parse"]:
                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, str(layout.control_worktree), "")
                if argv[:4] == ["git", "-C", str(layout.control_worktree), "status"]:

    raise SystemExit("dirty doctor test block missing")
text=text.replace(old,new,1)

            with (
                patch("do_again.cli.runtime_layout", return_value=layout),
                patch("do_again.cli.service_status", return_value={"installed": True, "running": True}),
                patch("do_again.cli.subprocess.run", side_effect=[clean, clean]),

            def doctor_git(argv, *args, **kwargs):

                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, str(layout.control_worktree), "")

    raise SystemExit("browser doctor test block missing")
text=text.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(text)

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
run(["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py"],env=env)
print("py_compile=ok")
focused=run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_cli","tests.test_service"],check=False,env=env)
